titleEn: The Glory of Kings — The Spirit of Prophecy Consoles Solomon (ch. 60, part 2)
part: ch. 60, part 2 — The Spirit of Prophecy Consoles Solomon
about: Solomon's lament continues: the kings and priests loved worldly things more than God's word, and God, who swore by himself to keep the world in order while Zion stayed on earth, has taken the Ark from them and given it to a people who obey him. The spirit of prophecy answers him: it was God's will, and the Ark was given to Solomon's own firstborn son, in keeping with the oath to David. Solomon is comforted and submits to God's will, and an angel appears and promises him God's love if he keeps the commandments. Several words in the long lists are uncertain.

sentences.t: መንግሥትኒ ፡ ኢይበቊዕ ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ ንጽሕ ፡ ወፍትሕ ፡ ኒ ፡ ኢይበቊዕ ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ ርትዕ ፡ ወብዕልኒ ፡ ኢይበቊዕ ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ ፍርሀተ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፤
sentences.l: Kingdom-too not-it-profits without purity, and-judgment too not-it-profits without uprightness, and-wealth-too not-it-profits without fear-of God;
sentences.i: A kingdom too is of no use without purity, judgment too is of no use without uprightness, and wealth too is of no use without the fear of God;
sentences.n: Solomon's lament now turns into a moral accusation. The frame is ኢይበቊዕ ዘእንበለ 'it does not profit without' (በቊዐ 'to avail, be of use'; ዘእንበለ 'without'), repeated three times, each subject carrying the particle -ኒ 'too, also' (መንግሥትኒ, ብዕልኒ). The middle one is printed ወፍትሕ ፡ ኒ with a space; I read it as ወፍትሕኒ 'and judgment too' (ፍትሕ 'judgment'). ንጽሕ 'purity', ርትዕ 'uprightness'. ፍርሀተ እግዚኣብሔር 'fear-of God' is a construct chain (ፍርሀት, construct ፍርሀተ). ወ- 'and' joins the clauses.

sentences.t: ካህናትኒ ፡ አፍቀሩ ፡ ነገረ ፡ ዘውዕ ፡ እምነገረ ፡ መጻሕፍት ፡ ወአፍቀሩ ፡ ቃለ ፡ መሰንቆ ፡ እምቃለ ፡ መዝሙር ፡ ወአፍቀሩ ፡ ግብረ ፡ ዓለም ፡ እምጸሎት ፡ ወአፍቀሩ ፡ ቅሥተ ፡ ዓለም ፡ እምቃለ ፡ መለኮት ፡ ወአፍቀሩ ፡ ሰሐቀ ፡ ወዝሙተ ፡ እምብካየ ፡ ሕይወት ፡ ወአፍቀሩ ፡ መብልዐ ፡ ኀላፊተ ፡ እምጸዊም ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወአፍቀሩ ፡ መስቴ ፡ ወስካረ ፡ እምሠዊዕ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወአፍቀሩ ፡ ሀኬተ ፡ እምስእለት ፡ ወአፍቀሩ ፡ ንዋየ ፡ እምነ ፡ ምጽወት ፡ ወአፍቀሩ ፡ ንዋመ ፡ እምስብሐት ፡ ወአፍቀሩ ፡ ነዛህላለ ፡ እምንቃህ ።
sentences.l: Priests-too loved talk-of chatter(?) more-than word-of books, and-they-loved voice-of lyre more-than voice-of psalm, and-they-loved work-of world more-than prayer, and-they-loved ?-of world(?) more-than word-of divinity, and-they-loved laughter and-fornication more-than weeping-of life(?), and-they-loved food passing more-than fasting for-God, and-they-loved drink and-drunkenness more-than offering for-God, and-they-loved idleness more-than petition, and-they-loved goods more-than alms, and-they-loved sleep more-than praise, and-they-loved drowsiness(?) more-than vigil.
sentences.i: The priests too loved idle talk (?) more than the words of the Scriptures; they loved the voice of the lyre more than the voice of the psalm, worldly work more than prayer, worldly pleasure (?) more than the word of divinity, laughter and lewdness more than weeping over life (?), passing food more than fasting for God, drink and drunkenness more than offering sacrifice to God, idleness more than petition, possessions more than almsgiving, sleep more than praise, and drowsiness (?) more than the vigil.
sentences.n: One catalogue built on a single pattern, አፍቀረ X እም Y 'he loved X more than Y' (እም- 'from, than' makes the comparison; ወአፍቀሩ 'and they loved', 3rd plural perfect). Many nouns stand in the construct state before a genitive: ነገረ መጻሕፍት 'word-of books (the Scriptures)', ቃለ መሰንቆ 'voice-of the lyre' (the masenqo), ቃለ መዝሙር 'voice-of psalm', ግብረ ዓለም 'work-of the world', ቃለ መለኮት 'word-of divinity', ብካየ ሕይወት 'weeping-of life'. There is no ፤ to cut at, so the unit stays long (about 48 words). Uncertain (?): ዘውዕ (I take it as 'idle talk', from the root of መስተዛውዓን in the next unit); ቅሥተ ዓለም (ቅሥት unknown to me, 'worldly pleasure' is a guess); ብካየ ሕይወት (could be 'weeping for life'); ነዛህላለ (probably 'drowsiness', set against ንቃህ 'vigil, wakefulness'). ሰሐቀ 'laughter' (ሰ is written for ሠ, so ሥሕቅ; (?)), ዝሙተ 'fornication' (here perhaps 'lewdness'); ንዋየ 'goods' vs ምጽወት 'alms'. Dillmann's lexicon was not available.

sentences.t: አሌለነ ፡ አሌለነ ፡ ነገሥትኒ ፡ ተሀከይነ ፡ እምነ ፡ ትእዛዘ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወአፍቀርነ ፡ ነገረ ፡ መስተዛውዓን ፡ እምቃለ ፡ ካህናትወገጸ ፡ አንስቲያነ ፡ ንፈቅድ ፡ ነጽሮ ፡ እምኀሢሠ ፡ ገጸ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ በንስሓ ፡ ወአፍቀርነ ፡ ነጽሮ ፡ ሕፃናቲነ ፡ እምሰሚዐ ፡ ቃለ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወአፍቀርነ ፡ ተናዝዞ ፡ በእብነ ፡ ሰርድዮን ፡ እምአርትዖ ፡ ፍትሕ ፡ ለእጓለ ፡ ማውታ ፡ ወአፍቀርነ ፡ ነጽሮ ፡ ክብርነ ፡ እምሰሚዐ ፡ ቃለ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወአፍቀርነ ፡ ነገረ ፡ በክ ፡ እምቃለ ፡ ማእምራን ፡ ወአፍቀርነ ፡ ነገረ ፡ እቡዳን ፡ እምነ ፡ ሰሚዐ ፡ ነገረ ፡ ነቢያት ።
sentences.l: Woe-to-us, woe-to-us, kings-too we-were-negligent from commandment-of God, and-we-loved talk-of chatterers more-than voice-of priests; and-face-of women-our we-desire seeing more-than seeking face-of God in-repentance, and-we-loved seeing little-ones-our more-than hearing word-of God, and-we-loved being-comforted(?) in-stone-of sardius more-than making-straight judgment for-child-of the-dead, and-we-loved seeing glory-our more-than hearing word-of God, and-we-loved talk-of (?) more-than voice-of knowers, and-we-loved talk-of fools more-than hearing talk-of prophets.
sentences.i: Woe to us, woe to us! We kings have neglected the commandment of God, and we have loved the talk of chatterers more than the voice of the priests. We want to gaze at the face of our women rather than seek the face of God in repentance; we have loved looking at our little ones more than hearing the word of God, taking comfort in the sardius stone more than setting judgment straight for the orphan, looking at our own splendor more than hearing the word of God, the talk of (?) more than the voice of the wise, and the talk of fools more than hearing the word of the prophets.
sentences.n: The refrain አሌለነ 'woe to us' (አሌ 'woe' + ለነ 'to us', as in part 1) opens the confession; now the speakers are the kings (ነገሥትኒ 'we kings too'). Same እም- comparison, now with 1st plural verbs (ወአፍቀርነ 'and we loved', -ነ 'we'). ተሀከይነ 'we were negligent' (ተሀከየ 'be slack'; same root as ሀኬተ 'idleness' in the last unit) takes እምነ 'from'. ካህናትወገጸ is printed as one word; I read ካህናት ወገጸ 'priests; and the face-of', so the sentence continues 'and the face of our women we desire to see'. ንፈቅድ ነጽሮ 'we desire to see' (verb + infinitive); ገጸ 'face-of' (construct of ገጽ); አንስቲያነ 'our women'. ተናዝዞ 'taking comfort' (infinitive of ተናዘዘ 'be comforted'; the sense is uncertain (?)) with እብነ ሰርድዮን 'stone-of sardius', a precious stone (Exodus 28:17), i.e. jewellery. አርትዖ ፍትሕ ለእጓለ ማውታ 'making judgment straight for the orphan' (እጓለ ማውታ 'offspring-of the dead' = orphan). መስተዛውዓን 'chatterers' (a participial form, reading uncertain (?)). ነገረ በክ: I cannot read በክ (?); it is set against ማእምራን 'those who know, the wise', and the next phrase has ነገረ እቡዳን 'talk-of fools' (plural እቡዳን of አብድ 'fool'). ነቢያት 'prophets'. There is no ፤ to cut at, so the unit stays long (about 51 words).

sentences.t: አሌለነ ፡ በፈቃድነ ፡ አርኰስና ፡ ለሕይወትነ ፤
sentences.l: Woe-to-us, by-will-our we-defiled-her to-life-our;
sentences.i: Woe to us! Of our own will we defiled our life;
sentences.n: አርኰስና is አርኰስነ 'we defiled' + ኣ 'her' (ነ + ኣ fuses to -ና, a pattern met again in ኢያእመርና below), doubled by ለሕይወትነ 'our life' (ለ- marks the object, as with ለታቦተ in part 1). አርኰሰ 'to make unclean, defile'. በፈቃድነ 'by our will' (በ- 'by, in').

sentences.t: አሌለነ ፡ እስመ ፡ ዘያፈቅር ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ንስሓ ፡ ወምሕረተ ፡ ኢገበርነ ፤
sentences.l: Woe-to-us, for what loves God, repentance and-mercy, not-we-did;
sentences.i: Woe to us! For what God loves, repentance and mercy, we did not do;
sentences.n: ዘያፈቅር እግዚኣብሔር 'what God loves' (ዘ- 'that which' + 3rd masc. imperfect ያፈቅር), a relative clause that stands as the object, with ንስሓ 'repentance' and ምሕረተ 'mercy' in apposition. ኢገበርነ 'we did not do' (ኢ- + 1st plural perfect). እስመ 'for, because'.

sentences.t: አሌለነ ፡ ወሀበነ ፡ ክብረ ፡ ወበእበድነ ፡ ገደፍነ ፡ አጥበበነ ፡ ፈድፋደ ፡ ወበፈቃድነ ፡ አበድነ ፡ እምነ ፡ እንስሳ ፡ ወሀበነ ፡ ብዕለ ፡ ወአንደይነ ፡ ርእስነ ፡ እምጽዋት ።
sentences.l: Woe-to-us, he-gave-us glory, and-in-our-folly we-cast-off; he-made-wise-us exceedingly, and-by-will-our we-were-foolish more-than beasts; he-gave-us wealth, and-we-impoverished(?) self-our from-alms.
sentences.i: Woe to us! He gave us glory, and in our folly we cast it off; he made us exceedingly wise, and by our own will we acted more foolishly than the beasts; he gave us wealth, and we impoverished ourselves (?) of almsgiving.
sentences.n: ወሀበነ 'he gave us' (ወሀበ + ነ 'us'); አጥበበነ 'he made us wise' (causative of ጠበበ 'be wise'); ፈድፋደ 'exceedingly'. ወበእበድነ ገደፍነ: በእበድነ 'in our folly' (እበድ 'folly'), ገደፍነ 'we cast off' (the 'it' is left unexpressed). አበድነ 'we were foolish' (አበደ 'be mad, foolish'), with እምነ እንስሳ 'more than beasts'. ወአንደይነ ርእስነ እምጽዋት: አንደየ is not a verb I know securely; I take it as a causative of ነደየ 'be poor' (cf. ነዳይ 'poor'), 'we made poor', with ርእስነ 'our head, ourselves' as object, so 'we impoverished ourselves (?) of almsgiving'. እምጽዋት = እም- + ጽዋት, or እም- + ምጽዋት 'alms' with the ም lost (?). Uncertain (?). ብዕል 'wealth'.

sentences.t: ነጸርነ ፡ አፍራሲነ ፡ ወረሳዕነ ፡ ምግባኢነ ፤
sentences.l: We-looked horses-our, and-we-forgot return-our(?);
sentences.i: We looked at our horses and forgot our return (?);
sentences.n: ነጸርነ 'we looked' (ነጸረ 'look at'), አፍራሲነ 'our horses' (አፍራስ 'horses'; compare the warning against horses in Deuteronomy 17:16 and Psalm 20:7, though the link is mine). ወረሳዕነ 'and we forgot' (ረሰዐ). ምግባኢ is from ገብአ 'return'; 'our return' is my reading and uncertain (?) — it could also be 'our reckoning, account'.

sentences.t: አፍቀርነ ፡ ኀላፊተ ፡ ወኢያእመርና ፡ ለነባሪት ፤
sentences.l: We-loved passing, and-not-we-knew-her to-abiding;
sentences.i: We loved what passes, and we did not know what abides;
sentences.n: አፍቀርነ 'we loved'; ኀላፊተ 'passing (thing)' (feminine); ኢያእመርና 'we did not know her' (አእመረ + ነ + ኣ, → -ና as above, doubled by ለነባሪት 'the abiding one', feminine participle of ነበረ 'stay, remain').

sentences.t: ረሰይነ ፡ መዋዕሊነ ፡ ተቀጽቦ ፡ ለሕይወትነ ፡ ወአብደርነ ፡ ተድላ ፡ ሲሲትነ ፡ ዘይከውን ፡ አደፈ ፡ እመብልዐ ፡ ሕይወት ፡ ዘይነብር ፡ ለዓለም ፡ ወቀጠንተ ፡ አልባስ ፡ ዘኢይበቊዕ ፡ ለነፍስ ፡ ወአእተትነልብሰ ፡ ግርማ ፡ ዘለዓለም ፤
sentences.l: We-made days-our (a) expectation(?) for-life-our, and-we-hastened(?) pleasure-of sustenance-our(?), which-is filth(?) beside food-of life which-abides forever, and thinness-of garments which-not-profits for-soul, and-we-removed garment-of majesty of-eternity;
sentences.i: We made our days a waiting (?) for our life, and hastened (?) the pleasure of our sustenance (?), which is filth (?) beside the food of the life that lasts forever, and the thinness of garments that does not profit the soul; and we put away the garment of everlasting majesty;
sentences.n: Hard in the first half. ረሰይነ 'we made, set' (ረሰየ 'set, make'); ተቀጽቦ I cannot place (?): from ቀጸበ, perhaps 'waiting, expectation' or 'cutting-short', so the English hedges. ሲሲትነ is unknown to me (?); 'sustenance' is a guess. አብደርነ 'we hastened (?)' (አብደረ, root uncertain). ተድላ 'pleasure'. ዘይከውን አደፈ እመብልዐ ሕይወት 'which is filth compared with the food of life' (እም- 'than'; አደፍ 'dirt', form uncertain (?)); ዘይነብር ለዓለም 'which abides forever' (ዘ- relative). ቀጠንተ አልባስ 'thinness-of garments' (construct), a second object of አብደርነ alongside ተድላ; ዘኢይበቊዕ ለነፍስ 'which does not profit the soul' (cf. ኢይበቊዕ in the first unit). አእተትነልብሰ is printed fused; I read አእተትነ ልብሰ 'we put away a garment' (አእተተ 'put away, remove'), then ግርማ ዘለዓለም 'majesty of eternity' (ልብሰ ግርማ 'garment-of majesty'). Allusion: the clothing of glory (Isaiah 61:10, Psalm 93:1).

sentences.t: ወመኳንንቲነኒ ፡ ወአሕዛብ ፡ ይገብሩ ፡ ዘይጸልእ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወኢያፍቀሩ ፡ ዘያፈቅር ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ፍቅረ ፡ ቢጾሙ ፡ ወትሕትና ፡ ወየውሀተ ፡ ወምሒረ ፡ ነዳይ ፡ ወትዕግሥተ ፡ ወአፍቅሮ ፡ ቤተ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወሰጊድ ፡ ለወልድ ፤
sentences.l: And-governors-our-too and-nations they-do what hates God, and-not-they-love what loves God: love-of neighbor-their, and-humility, and-gentleness(?), and-mercy-of(?) poor, and-patience, and-loving house-of God, and-prostration to-Son;
sentences.i: And our governors too, and the nations, do what God hates and do not love what God loves: love of their neighbor, humility, gentleness (?), mercy toward the poor (?), patience, love for the house of God, and prostration before the Son;
sentences.n: መኳንንቲነኒ 'and our governors too' (መኰንን 'governor, judge', plural መኳንንት + ነ 'our' + -ኒ 'too'). ዘይጸልእ እግዚኣብሔር 'what God hates' against ዘያፈቅር 'what he loves' (ዘ- as 'that which'). Then a list of the loved things in the accusative: ፍቅረ ቢጾሙ 'love-of their neighbour' (construct), ትሕትና 'humility', ወየውሀተ 'gentleness (?)' (ወ- + የውሀት, unfamiliar to me), ምሒረ ነዳይ 'mercy-of the poor', ትዕግሥተ 'patience', ወአፍቅሮ ቤተ እግዚኣብሔር 'and loving the house of God' (infinitive), ወሰጊድ ለወልድ 'and bowing to the Son' (ወልድ 'Son', the Second Person; Christian language in Solomon's mouth).

sentences.t: ወዘይጸልእሰ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ተጠይሮ ፡ ወአጣዕዎ ፡ ወሐቲተ ፡ ማሪት ፡ ወመቃስም ፡ ወሰገል ፡ ወጽንጽንያ ፡ ወአቀሪኖ ፡ ወብትክ ፡ ወማውታ ፡ ወስርቅ ፡ ወዐመፃ ፡ ወዝሙት ፡ ወተቃንኦ ፡ ወሐቢል ፡ ወስታይ ፡ ወስካር ፡ ወማሕላ ፡ በሐሰት ፡ ለቢጾሙ ፡ ወስምዐ ፡ ሐሰት ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ቢጾሙ ፡ ዘንተ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ይገብሩ ፡ ዘይጸልእ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ።
sentences.l: And-what hates-indeed God: ?(?), and-idolatry(?), and-?-of ?(?), and-divination(?), and-sorcery(?), and-?(?), and-?(?), and-?(?), and-the-dead(?), and-theft, and-injustice, and-fornication, and-envy, and-?(?), and-drinking, and-drunkenness, and-oath in-falsehood to-neighbor-their, and-witness-of falsehood against neighbor-their; this all they-do which hates God.
sentences.i: And what God hates is: ... idolatry (?), ... divination (?), sorcery (?), ..., ..., ..., the dead (?), theft, injustice, fornication, envy, ..., drinking and drunkenness, false oaths made to their neighbors, and false witness against their neighbors; all this they do, which God hates.
sentences.n: The counterpart list, items joined by ወ-. I give the readable items and mark the rest, since Dillmann was unavailable (?): ተጠይሮ (unknown; perhaps 'disdain'), ወአጣዕዎ (from ጣዖት 'idol': 'idolatry'?), ሐቲተ ማሪት (ሐቲት 'inquiry' + ?), መቃስም ('diviners, divination', from ቀሰመ), ሰገል ('sorcery'?), ጽንጽንያ (?), አቀሪኖ (?), ብትክ (?), ማውታ ('the dead', as in እጓለ ማውታ; out of place in this list, perhaps necromancy (?)), ሐቢል (?). Clear ones: ስርቅ 'theft', ዐመፃ 'injustice', ዝሙት 'fornication', ተቃንኦ 'envy, zeal', ስታይ 'drinking', ስካር 'drunkenness', ማሕላ በሐሰት 'an oath in falsehood', ስምዐ ሐሰት 'witness-of falsehood' (false witness; Exodus 20:16). The last clause is a summary, ዘንተ ኵሎ ይገብሩ ዘይጸልእ እግዚኣብሔር 'this all they do which God hates'. ዘይጸልእሰ: -ሰ 'indeed, as for' marks the contrast with the loved things above. The English is rough where marked (?); the Geʿez is as printed.

sentences.t: ወበእንተ ፡ ዝንቱኬ ፡ ዘነሥኣ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ለታቦተ ፡ ኪዳኑ ፡ እምኔነ ፡ ወወሀባ ፡ ለሕዝብ ፡ እለ ፡ ይገብሩ ፡ ፈቃዶ ፡ ወሕጎ ፡ ወሥርዐቶ ፤
sentences.l: And-on-account-of this-indeed, that-he-took-her God to-ark-of covenant-his from-us and-gave-her to-people who do will-his and-law-his and-ordinance-his;
sentences.i: And it is for this reason, indeed, that God took the Ark of his covenant from us and gave it to a people who do his will, his law and his ordinance;
sentences.n: ወበእንተ ዝንቱኬ 'and because of this indeed' (በእንተ 'on account of'; ዝንቱ 'this' + -ኬ emphatic). ዘነሥኣ እግዚኣብሔር ለታቦተ ኪዳኑ 'that God took her, the Ark of his covenant' (ዘ- here 'that, the fact that'; ነሥአ 'take'; -ኣ 'her' doubled by ለታቦተ). ታቦተ ኪዳን 'ark-of covenant', as in part 1. ወወሀባ 'and gave her'. እለ ይገብሩ 'who do' (እለ plural relative). ፈቃዶ ወሕጎ ወሥርዐቶ 'his will, his law, his ordinance'. The 'people' who receive the Ark are Ethiopia in the story's reading, but Solomon does not yet say so.

sentences.t: ሜጠ ፡ ገጾ ፡ እምኔነ ፡ ወአብርሀ ፡ ገጾ ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ ፡ ተሀየየ ፡ ኪያነ ፡ ወአፍቀረ ፡ ኪያሆሙ ፡ መሐረ ፡ ኪያሆሙ ፡ ወአጥፍአ ፡ ኪያነ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ዘነሥኣ ፡ ለታቦተ ፡ ኪዳኑ ፡ እምኔነ ።
sentences.l: He-turned face-his from-us and-made-shine face-his upon-them; he-turned-from(?) us and-loved them, he-had-mercy-on them and-destroyed us, on-account-of that-he-took-her to-ark-of covenant-his from-us.
sentences.i: He turned his face from us and made it shine upon them; he turned away (?) from us and loved them, he had mercy on them and destroyed us, because he took the Ark of his covenant from us.
sentences.n: ሜጠ ገጾ 'he turned his face' (the idiom of God's withdrawal), against ወአብርሀ ገጾ ላዕሌሆሙ 'and made his face shine upon them' (cf. the blessing of Numbers 6:25, Psalm 67:1). ኪያነ ... ኪያሆሙ 'us ... them' are the accusative pronouns ኪያ- + ነ/ሆሙ. ተሀየየ 'turned away (?)' as in part 1 (uncertain). አፍቀረ 'loved', መሐረ 'had mercy', አጥፍአ 'destroyed' (አጥፍአ, the same verb as the earlier አጥፋእከ; here the final -ኣ is part of the 3rd masc. form, 'he destroyed'). The closing clause repeats the reason, በእንተ ዘነሥኣ.

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ መሐለ ፡ ማሕላ ፡ በርእሱ ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢይከልእ ፡ ክረምተ ፡ ወሐጋየ ፡ ዘርአ ፡ ወማእረረ ፡ ፍሬ ፡ ወተግባረ ፡ ፀሐየ ፡ ወወርኀ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ሀለወት ፡ ጽዮን ፡ ዲበ ፡ ምድር ፡ ወከመ ፡ ኢይትመዐዕ ፡ ለሰማይ ፡ ወምድር ፡ ኢበአይኅ ፡ ወኢበእሳት ፡ ወከመ ፡ ኢያጠፍእ ፡ ሰብአ ፡ ወእንስሳ ፡ ወአራዊተ ፡ አላ ፡ ዳእሙ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይምሐር ፡ ተግባረ ፡ እደዊሁ ፡ ወከመ ፡ ያብዝኅ ፡ ምሕረቶላዕለ ፡ ልሕኵቱ ፤
sentences.l: For he-swore oath by-himself that not he-withhold winter and-summer seed and-harvest-of fruit and-work-of sun and-moon while she-was Zion on earth, and that not he-be-angry with-heaven and-earth by-flood nor-by-fire, and that not he-destroy man and-beast and-wild-animals, but rather that he-have-mercy-on work-of hands-his, and that he-multiply mercy-his upon creature-his(?);
sentences.i: For he swore an oath by himself that he would not withhold the winter and the summer, the seedtime and the harvest of fruit, or the work of the sun and the moon, so long as Zion was on earth; that he would not be angry with heaven and earth by flood or by fire, nor destroy man, beast or wild animals; but rather that he would have mercy on the work of his hands and multiply his mercy upon his creature (?);
sentences.n: The oath refers to Genesis 8:21–22 (after the flood, seedtime and harvest, cold and heat, summer and winter will not cease) and Genesis 9:11, and to Hebrews 6:13 (God swearing by himself). መሐለ ማሕላ 'he swore an oath' (verb + cognate accusative); በርእሱ 'by himself' (literally 'by his head'). ከመ ኢይከልእ 'that he not withhold' (ከመ + subjunctive; the same ከመ ኢ- opens each negative clause). ክረምተ 'winter, rainy season', ሐጋየ 'summer' (ሐጋይ), ዘርአ ወማእረረ ፍሬ 'seed(time) and harvest-of fruit' (ዘርአ 'seed' is its own item, the pair ዘርአ ወማእረረ as elsewhere; ፍሬ completes the construct ማእረረ), ተግባረ ፀሐየ ወወርኀ 'work-of sun and moon'. እንዘ ሀለወት ጽዮን ዲበ ምድር 'while Zion was upon the earth': the condition ties the world's order to the Ark's presence (feminine ሀለወት). ኢበአይኅ ወኢበእሳት 'not by flood nor by fire' (አይኅ 'flood'). አላ ዳእሙ 'but rather'. ምሕረቶላዕለ is printed fused; I read ምሕረቶ ላዕለ 'his mercy upon'. ልሕኵቱ: from ልሕከ 'stick, adhere', so something like 'his moulded thing, creature' (?); uncertain.

sentences.t: ወአመ ፡ ይነሥኣ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ለታቦተ ፡ ኪዳኑ ፡ አሜሃ ፡ ያጠፍኦሙ ፡ ለሰማያት ፡ ወምድር ፡ ወለኵሉ ፡ ተግባሩ ፤
sentences.l: And-when he-takes-her God, ark-of covenant-his, then he-will-destroy-them, the-heavens and-earth and-all works-his;
sentences.i: And when God takes the Ark of his covenant, then he will destroy the heavens and the earth and all his works;
sentences.n: The logical end of the oath: if the Ark goes, the world goes. ወአመ ይነሥኣ 'and when he takes her' (አመ 'when' + imperfect); አሜሃ 'then'; ያጠፍኦሙ ለሰማያት 'he will destroy them, the heavens' (the pronoun -ሙ doubled by ለ-). ተግባሩ 'his works'.

sentences.t: ወዮምኒ ፡ እስመ ፡ ተሀየየነ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወነሥኣ ፡ እምኔነ ፡ ለታቦተ ፡ ሕጉ ፨
sentences.l: And-today-too, since he-turned-from-us God and-took-her from-us, ark-of law-his.
sentences.i: And today, since God has turned away (?) from us and taken from us the Ark of his law —
sentences.n: This unit ends at ፨, a mid-text paragraph-break mark in the source (not the end of the part). ወዮምኒ 'and today too'; ተሀየየነ 'he turned from us' (?, as in part 1). ታቦተ ሕጉ 'ark-of his law' (a variant name of ታቦተ ኪዳን). The sentence has no main clause; it breaks off in grief, which the next unit says.

sentences.t: ወዘንተ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ይብል ፡ ኢያዐርፍ ፡ ብካየ ፡ ወአንብዐ ፡ እምአዕይንቲሁ ።
sentences.l: And-this while he-says, not-he-ceased weeping, and tears from eyes-his.
sentences.i: While he said this, he did not cease weeping, or the tears from his eyes.
sentences.n: ወዘንተ እንዘ ይብል 'and this while he says' (እንዘ + imperfect, 'while saying'; ዘንተ 'this', accusative). ኢያዐርፍ ብካየ 'he did not rest from weeping' (አዐረፈ 'rest, cease'; ብካየ is the verbal noun, as in ወበከየ ብካየ in part 1). ወአንብዐ 'and tears' (አንብዕ 'tear', accusative plural, a second object of ኢያዐርፍ beside ብካየ; it could instead be a verb 'and he shed tears').

sentences.t: ወአውሥአ ፡ መንፈሰ ፡ ትንቢት ፡ እንዘ ፡ ይብሎ ፡ ለምንት ፡ ከመዝ ፡ ተሐዝን ፡ እስመ ፡ በፈቃደ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ኮነ ፡ ዝንቱ ፡ ወይእቲኒ ፡ አኮ ፡ ለባዕድ ፡ ዘተውህበት ፡ አላ ፡ ለወልድከ ፡ ቀዳሜ ፡ በኵርከ ፡ ዘይነብር ፡ ዲበ ፡ መንበረ ፡ ዳዊት ፡ አቡከ ፤
sentences.l: And-answered spirit-of prophecy while it-says to-him: 'Why thus you-grieve? For by-will-of God was this, and-she-too not to-stranger which-was-given, but to-son-your first-of(?) firstborn-your, who-sits on throne-of David father-your;
sentences.i: And the spirit of prophecy answered him, saying, 'Why do you grieve so? This happened by the will of God, and she too was not given to a stranger, but to your son, the first of your firstborn (?), who sits on the throne of David your father;
sentences.n: መንፈሰ ትንቢት 'spirit-of prophecy' (construct chain; the voice of the prophets speaks to Solomon, as a character in the story). ወአውሥአ 'and he answered' (አውሥአ; እንዘ ይብሎ 'while saying to him', ይብሎ = ይብል + ለ + ሁ). ለምንት ከመዝ ተሐዝን 'why do you grieve thus?' (ተሐዝን, 2nd masc. imperfect of ሐዘነ). እስመ በፈቃደ እግዚኣብሔር ኮነ ዝንቱ 'for this was by the will of God' (ፈቃደ 'will-of'). ይእቲኒ 'she too' (the Ark, feminine). አኮ ለባዕድ 'not to a stranger'; ዘተውህበት 'she who was given' (ተውህበ passive of ወሀበ). ወልድከ ... በኵርከ 'your son, your firstborn': Menelik, son of Solomon and the Queen of Sheba, though the speaker does not name him; ቀዳሜ 'first-of' (the construct form, as in the known entry; the construction is unclear (?)). መንበረ ዳዊት 'throne-of David' (2 Samuel 7:13, 16).

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ መሐለ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ለዳዊት ፡ በጽድቅ ፡ ወኢይኔስሕ ፡ ከመ ፡ እምፍሬ ፡ ከርሡ ፡ ያነብር ፡ ዲበ ፡ መንበሩ ፡ እስከ ፡ ለዓለም ፡ በውስተ ፡ ታቦተ ፡ ኪዳኑ ፡ ጽዮን ፡ ቅድስት ፤
sentences.l: for he-swore God to-David in-truth and-not-he-will-repent that from-fruit-of belly-his he-set on throne-his forever, in ark-of covenant-his, Zion holy;
sentences.i: for God swore to David in truth, and will not repent, that he would set one from the fruit of his body upon his throne forever, in the Ark of his covenant, holy Zion;
sentences.n: The Davidic oath: Psalm 132:11–12 ('The Lord has sworn to David a sure oath from which he will not turn: one of the fruit of your body I will set on your throne') and Psalm 89:3–4, 35–37; 2 Samuel 7:12–16. መሐለ ለዳዊት በጽድቅ 'he swore to David in truth'; ኢይኔስሕ 'he will not repent' (ነስሐ 'repent, change his mind'). ከመ 'that' introduces the content of the oath; እምፍሬ ከርሡ 'from the fruit-of his belly' (construct chain; ከርሥ 'belly, womb'); ያነብር 'he set, he is to set' (3ms subjunctive after ከመ; አነበረ, causative of ነበረ 'sit'). In the story, the 'fruit' is Solomon's line, and the Ark's new home is the place where the oath is kept. በውስተ ታቦተ ኪዳኑ ጽዮን ቅድስት 'in the Ark of his covenant, holy Zion': ጽዮን is in apposition, the Ark and Zion being one.

sentences.t: ወእሬስዮ ፡ ልዑለ ፡ እምነገሥተ ፡ ምድር ፡ ወመንበሮሂ ፡ ከመ ፡ መዋዕለ ፡ ሰማይ ፡ ወከመ ፡ ሥርዐተ ፡ ወርኅ ፡ እስከ ፡ ለዓለም ፤
sentences.l: and-I-will-make-him high above-kings-of earth, and-throne-his-also like days-of heaven and like order-of moon forever;
sentences.i: and I will make him high above the kings of the earth, and his throne too will be like the days of heaven and like the order of the moon forever;
sentences.n: Psalm 89:27, 29, 36–37 (the king made 'the highest of the kings of the earth', his throne 'as the days of heaven', 'like the moon, established for ever'). ወእሬስዮ 'and I will make him' (1st sg imperfect of ረሰየ 'set, make'), now in the voice of God. ልዑለ 'high' (accusative); እምነገሥተ ምድር 'above the kings-of earth' (እም- 'than, above'). መንበሮሂ 'and his throne too' (-ሂ). መዋዕለ ሰማይ 'days-of heaven', ሥርዐተ ወርኅ 'order-of the moon' (construct chains). እስከ ለዓለም 'until forever'.

sentences.t: ወበሰማያትኒ ፡ ዘይነብር ፡ ዲበ ፡ መንበረ ፡ መለኮት ፡ በሥጋ ፡ ይኴንን ፡ ሕያዋነ ፡ ወሙታነ ፡ እስከ ፡ ለዓለም ፡ ወይገንዩ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ መላእክት ፡ ወሰብእ ፡ ወይሴብሖ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ልሳን ፡ ወይሰግዱ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ብርክ ፡ በቀላያት ፡ ወበአፍላግ ፤
sentences.l: and-in-the-heavens-too he-who sits on throne-of divinity in-flesh he-will-judge living and-dead forever, and-they-will-serve him angels and-men, and-will-praise-him every tongue, and-will-bow to-him every knee, in-seas and-in-rivers;
sentences.i: and in heaven too the one who sits on the throne of divinity in the flesh will judge the living and the dead forever; angels and men will serve him, every tongue will praise him, and every knee will bow to him, in the seas and in the rivers;
sentences.n: The oath is read as fulfilled in Christ: the descendant of David sits on the throne of divinity ሕያዋነ ወሙታነ 'the living and the dead' (cf. 2 Timothy 4:1; the creed), and every knee bows and every tongue praises (Philippians 2:10–11, Isaiah 45:23). በሰማያትኒ 'in the heavens too'; ዘይነብር 'he who sits'; መንበረ መለኮት 'throne-of divinity' (construct); በሥጋ 'in flesh'. ይኴንን 'he will judge' (ኰነነ). ይገንዩ ሎቱ 'they will serve him' (ገንየ 'serve, bow'; ሎቱ 'to him'); ይሴብሖ 'it (every tongue) will praise him' (-ሖ = 3rd masc. object suffix); ብርክ 'knee'; ቀላያት 'seas, deeps' and አፍላግ 'rivers' (cf. Psalm 89:25).

sentences.t: ወበዝንቱ ፡ ተናዘዝ ፡ ወግባእ ፡ ቤትከወኢታሕዝን ፡ ልብከ ፡ ፍጹመ ።
sentences.l: and-in-this be-comforted and-return house-your, and-not grieve heart-your completely.
sentences.i: Take comfort in this, and go back to your house, and do not grieve your heart utterly.'
sentences.n: The prophetic voice now commands: ተናዘዝ 'be comforted' (imperative of ተናዘዘ, as in the next unit), ግባእ 'return' (imperative of ገብአ), ወኢታሕዝን 'and do not grieve' (ኢ- + 2nd masc. imperfect of አሕዘነ 'to grieve'). ቤትከወኢታሕዝን is printed as one word; I read ቤትከ ወኢታሕዝን 'your house, and do not grieve'. ልብከ 'your heart', ፍጹመ 'completely'. በዝንቱ 'in this' (በ- 'in, by').

sentences.t: ወበዝንቱ ፡ ተናዘዘ ፡ ወይቤ ፡ ይኩን ፡ ፈቃዱ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወአኮ ፡ ፈቃደ ፡ ሰብእ ።
sentences.l: And-in-this he-was-comforted and-said: 'Let-be will-his of-God, and-not will-of man.'
sentences.i: And in this he was comforted, and said, 'Let it be God's will, and not the will of man.'
sentences.n: ተናዘዘ 'he was comforted' (3rd masc. perfect; the sense 'confess' is also possible for this stem, so I say 'comforted' because the context is consolation). ይኩን ፈቃዱ ለእግዚኣብሔር 'let his will be (that) of God' (ኮነ 'be', jussive; ለ- of possession). ወአኮ ፈቃደ ሰብእ 'and not the will-of man' (አኮ 'not', a nominal negative). The wording recalls 'not my will but yours' (Luke 22:42).

sentences.t: ወካዕበ ፡ አስተርአዮ ፡ መልአከ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ገሃደ ፡ ወይቤሎ ፡ ወአንተሰ ፡ ሐነጽከ ፡ ቤተ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወትከውነከ ፡ ምክሐ ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ወምስማከ ፡ ለእመ ፡ ዐቀብከ ፡ ትእዛዞ ፡ ወኢያምለከ ፡ ባዕደ ፡ አማልክተ ፡ ትትፈቀር ፡ በኀበ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ከመ ፡ ዳዊት ፡ አቡከ ፨ ፨ ፨
sentences.l: And-again he-appeared-to-him angel-of God openly and-said-to-him: 'And-you-indeed you-built house-of God, and-she-will-be-for-you boast she and-support(?), if you-kept commandments-his and-not-you-worshiped other gods, you-will-be-loved before God like David father-your.' ፨ ፨ ፨
sentences.i: And again the angel of God appeared to him openly and said to him, 'As for you, you built the house of God, and it will be your boast and your support (?), if you keep his commandments and do not worship other gods; then you will be loved in God's sight like David your father.'
sentences.n: ወካዕበ 'and again'; አስተርአዮ 'he appeared to him' (አስተርአየ, the stem for a vision or epiphany; -ዮ = + ሁ 'him'); መልአከ እግዚኣብሔር 'angel-of God'; ገሃደ 'openly, plainly'. ወአንተሰ 'and you, for your part' (-ሰ contrast). ሐነጽከ ቤተ እግዚኣብሔር 'you built the house of God' (the Temple). ትከውነከ ምክሐ ይእቲ 'she will be for you a boast' (-ከ 'to you'; ይእቲ 'she' stresses the subject, probably the house, but it may mean the Ark (?)). ምስማከ is 'support, prop' (ምስማክ), reading uncertain (?). ለእመ ዐቀብከ ትእዛዞ 'if you keep his commandments' (ዐቀበ 'keep'); ወኢያምለከ 'and you do not worship' (አምለከ 'worship'; written for a perfect 2nd masc. with -ከ ending written once, as ተመነነ in part 1; the form is uncertain (?)). ባዕደ አማልክተ 'other gods'. ትትፈቀር በኀበ እግዚኣብሔር 'you will be loved before God' (a passive imperfect). The condition echoes 1 Kings 9:4–9 (God to Solomon: if you walk as David your father did... but if you turn away and serve other gods) and 2 Samuel 7:14–15. ከመ ዳዊት አቡከ 'like David your father'. The part ends here, at the final ፨ ፨ ፨ of the source text.
